abstract: INTRODUCTION: Choriocarcinoma is form of malignant neoplasm that arise from trophoblastic cells that occurs mostly in ovaries and testes and it can metastasis to lungs, liver or to gastrointestinal tract. PRESENTATION OF CASE: This is 37 years old female presented as a case of lower gi bleeding and was diagnosed to have metastatic jejunal and ilium choriocarcinoma of unknown primary and underwent ileocecal resection first then followed up with small bowel resection around 60 cm from duodenojejunal junction with primary anastomosis. The patient was found to have liver and brain metastasis and received chemotherapy with full response. DISCUSSION: Choriocarcinoma is the most aggressive form of gestational trophoblastic disease that metastasizes through the lymphatic and hematogenous routes, and when its metastasis to the small bowel it's considered the worst prognosis with high mortality rate. Treatment consists of surgery and combined chemotherapy which is what our patient responded with. CONCLUSION: Metastatic choriocarcinoma with unknown primary can be treated surgically with chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: はじめに：絨毛癌は栄養膜細胞から生じる悪性腫瘍であり、主に卵巣と精巣に発生し、肺、肝臓、消化管へ転移しうる。症例提示：37歳女性が下部消化管出血で受診し、原発不明の転移性空腸・回腸絨毛癌と診断された。回盲部切除を行い、その後、十二指腸空腸曲から約60cmの小腸切除と一次吻合を行った。肝転移および脳転移を認め、化学療法を受けて完全奏効が得られた。考察：絨毛癌は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の中で最も侵襲性の高い型であり、リンパ行性および血行性に転移する。小腸への転移は予後不良で死亡率が高いとされる。治療は手術と併用化学療法であり、本患者は化学療法に反応した。結論：原発不明の転移性絨毛癌は、手術と化学療法により治療可能である。
